biggest_gap.title: A driver can still act uncounted or finish off the clock through the page: async continuations escape the sentinel, and the after-clock freeze does not stop late answers
biggest_gap.detail:
Round 6 closed the Node side (the sandboxed driver process). The browser side is still open in two ways.

(1) Uncounted actions. The sentinel only refuses what the condition does synchronously. Anything it schedules runs after disarm() puts every refused method back: a native `await` (which never calls the patched Promise.prototype.then), `Element.animate().onfinish`, and similar callbacks. A ctx.read or op.waitFor condition can therefore fill fields and click Save with no step counted. The MutationObserver, focus and address checks look only at the synchronous window.

(2) Wrong timer. Emulation.setScriptExecutionDisabled does not stop the page's in-flight fetch continuations. A driver can return from run() before the product answers, and verify() can read the page in short ctx.reads until the answer is on screen. The meter misses this:
- page reads are not 'repeated back-end reads';
- each pause stays under 1 s;
- the slower-first-pass rule needs a gap over 3 s.

The harness's own T2b test waits only 0.9 s on a 2 s answer, so it cannot see the freeze fail. Removing freezePages altogether leaves the suite green (mutation M5).

Possible fixes:
- Run conditions in an isolated world (Playwright's utility world or a CDP isolated context) so page globals and the product's handlers are out of reach.
- Or refuse any condition whose source contains async, await, function scheduling or observer constructors, and keep the sentinel armed until the next turn of the page's event loop (check for DOM mutations and requests started after the condition returns, before the next counted step).
- Treat any non-GET request, or any DOM change, that starts while no counted step is in progress as an uncounted action.
- Make the freeze real: pause the page with Debugger.pause, or abort in-flight responses at the clock and snapshot the DOM there.
- Make verify() read a DOM snapshot taken at finish(), not the live page.
- Add S1, S2 and T3 as self-tests. Also test that the frozen screen stays unchanged after more than the product's answer time.
